caption: The trial account: Individual Trial Global, active until 26 November 2026, with automatic renewal on. Parts of the account block are hidden.
Keyword research for coffee grinder on google.com returned volume 480, CPC 0.52 and difficulty 25 out of 100 in about 6 seconds.
Backlink analysis refused wikipedia.org: the data is unavailable for domains with a large backlink profile.
For seranking.com the trial lists 2,000 backlinks out of 212,514 in total.
A site audit of example.org scanned 1 page and gave an SDO score of 84 with 4 high priority issues, in about 15 seconds.
AI Visibility is not included in the trial plan.
Ending the trial: the dialog says most reports and tools lock once auto-payment is cancelled, and the trial runs to 26 November. Parts of the account block are hidden.
